Description: Write educational content solving your audience's problems. SEO optimized. Compounds over time — your best long-term asset.
Anti_Pattern: Writing content nobody searches for|Publishing without distribution plan|Expecting results in month 1
Impact_Preview: 3-6 months to first organic traffic. 100-1K visitors/mo by month 6. $0-25/mo cost. Compounds forever — best long-term ROI.

Description: Build in public. Share journey + learnings. Engage with community. Best for developer tools and personal brands.
Impact_Preview: 1-3 months to build following. 500-5K followers achievable. $0 cost. Build-in-public threads get 10x engagement vs promotional.

Description: Single-day traffic spike. Prepare 1 week ahead: maker profile + teaser + community support. Feature = 1-5K visitors.
Anti_Pattern: Launching without preparation|Launching too early (before core loop works)|Expecting sustained traffic from 1 launch
Impact_Preview: 5K-15K visitors on launch day. $0 cost, 1 week prep. 68% of SaaS products get 200+ upvotes. One-shot first impression.

Description: Show HN post with genuine story. Best for technical products. Can drive 5-50K visitors if it hits front page.
Anti_Pattern: Posting marketing fluff|Astroturfing (fake upvotes)|Being defensive in comments
Impact_Preview: 5-50K visitors if front page. $0 cost, 2 hrs prep. Authentic technical stories perform best. Comments section can make or break.

Description: Research keywords → create best content for that query → optimize on-page. Longest payback but highest ROI over time.
Anti_Pattern: Targeting only high-competition keywords|Ignoring search intent|Keyword stuffing
Impact_Preview: 6-12 months to rank. 1K-10K visitors/mo when ranking page 1. $0-29/mo (Ahrefs free). Highest ROI long-term but slowest start.

Description: Owned audience. Highest conversion of any channel (40:1 ROI). Build list from day 1. Biweekly minimum.
Anti_Pattern: Emailing without permission|No value — only promotions|Sending too frequently
Impact_Preview: 40:1 ROI — highest conversion of any channel. 500-5K subscribers in 6 months. $0-29/mo. You own the audience, no algorithm risk.

Description: Build owned community around your product. Answer questions. Let users help each other. Becomes Micro-MOAT ⑤.
Anti_Pattern: Building community too early (before PMF)|Not moderating|Only lurking
Impact_Preview: 3-6 months to active community. 100-500 members in first year. $0 cost. Becomes Micro-MOAT when users help each other.

Anti_Pattern: Long-form tutorials and product demos. Second largest search engine. Videos rank in Google too.
Source: Over-producing videos|Waiting for perfect quality|No call-to-action
Reversibility: 6-12 months to grow channel. 100-1K subscribers in first year. $0 + $50 mic. Videos rank in Google too — dual traffic source.

Description: Cross-post technical content. Built-in developer audience. Low effort if already writing blog posts.
Anti_Pattern: Only cross-posting without engaging|Spamming with promotional content
Impact_Preview: 1-3 months for developer audience. 100-1K followers. $0 cost. Cross-post from blog = near-zero additional effort.

Description: Find relevant subreddits. Contribute genuinely. Share product only when it genuinely helps someone's question.
Anti_Pattern: Self-promotion without contributing|Creating fake posts|Ignoring subreddit rules
Impact_Preview: 1-3 months to build karma. Genuine contribution converts 2-5% of readers. $0 cost. High risk of ban if promotional.

Description: Professional storytelling. Best for B2B SaaS. Share insights — not pitches. Engagement > broadcasting.
Anti_Pattern: Cold pitching in DMs|Only sharing company updates|Auto-connecting without personalization
Impact_Preview: 1-3 months to grow reach. 500-2K connections. $0 cost. B2B sweet spot — professional stories get 5x engagement vs company posts.

Description: Incentivize users to invite others. Works best when product has inherent sharing (Calendly link = marketing). Build into core action.
Anti_Pattern: Launching referral before PMF|Over-complex reward system|Rewarding signups instead of activation
Impact_Preview: 1-3 months to see viral loop. 10-30% referral rate when aligned with core action. $0-500 setup. Only works with product-inherent sharing.

Description: Find non-competing products with same audience. Guest post, co-webinar, bundle deals. Mutual benefit.
Anti_Pattern: Partnering with competitors|Asymmetric partnerships (you do all the work)|Too many partnerships at once
Impact_Preview: 1-3 months to establish partnerships. 2-5 active partnerships per quarter. $0 cost. Mutual benefit required for sustainability.

Description: ONLY after organic works and unit economics are positive. Set daily budgets. A/B test ruthlessly.
Anti_Pattern: Running ads before PMF|No tracking/attribution|Broad targeting burns budget|Running ads before organic channel works
Impact_Preview: 1-3 months to optimize. $500+/mo spend. ROAS 3-5x when unit economics proven. Burns cash fast if funnel not optimized.

Description: Personalized outreach to 10-20 prospects/day. Only for high-ticket B2B. Automate research not personalization.
Anti_Pattern: Mass generic emails|Buying email lists|Not following up (80% of deals need 5+ touches)|Using this for B2C
Impact_Preview: 1-2 months to see responses. 2-5% response rate for personalized B2B. $0-50/mo. Only viable for high-ticket products ($1K+/deal).
